klaim.bukti: We concentrate on the types, focuses, considerations, methods, and contributions of literature reviews as independent, standalone studies [...] without getting entangled in the complexities of review procedures, protocols, and nomenclatures.
klaim.perbaikan: Reporting follows PRISMA 2020 where the items apply to a mapping review [page2021prisma, page2021elaboration], and general guidance on conducting and reporting stand-alone literature reviews from management research [kraus2022] and from transport research [vanwee2016howto] was used to decide what to report.
klaim.catatan: Kraus dkk. terbit di Review of Managerial Science (bidang manajemen, bukan teknik). Abstrak menyatakan panduan umum tentang jenis, fokus, pertimbangan, metode, dan kontribusi tinjauan, dan secara eksplisit menghindari kerumitan protokol; frasa 'protocol elements recommended' tidak didukung abstrak. Teks lengkap tidak terbaca.

klaim.bukti: captures images of blueberry plants from three distinct views (top, left, and right) [...] Accounting for the overlapping information from the three views, we employ a regression model to estimate the total number of blueberries per plant.
klaim.catatan: Tiga pandangan, regresi, dan tumpang-tindih antarpandangan sesuai abstrak. Platform adalah wahana darat bergerak multikamera, bukan UAV; kalimat naskah tidak menyatakan Li dkk. memakai UAV secara eksplisit, tetapi pembukanya ('common in UAV work') dapat menimbulkan kesan itu.

klaim.bukti: This work presents Depth Anything V2. Without pursuing fancy techniques, we aim to reveal crucial findings to pave the way towards building a powerful monocular depth estimation model.
klaim.catatan: Depth Anything V2 (NeurIPS 2024) adalah model estimasi kedalaman monokular; kedalaman diprediksi dari satu citra RGB tanpa sensor kedalaman.

klaim.bukti: For the orange dataset, the uncorrected model has an L1 loss of 593, an error mean of 17.1% and a standard deviation of 26.3%. After the 3D reconstruction correction step, the model has an L1 loss of 203, an error mean of -0.2%
klaim.perbaikan: Crop cell: 'Orange, apple' (not 'Mango, citrus'). Result cell may give the numbers: count error mean fell from 17.2% to -0.2% for oranges and from 8.5% to 3.3% for apples after the SfM correction (L1 loss 593 to 203 and 673 to 322).
klaim.catatan: Tanaman salah: makalah mengevaluasi jeruk (siang, Booth Ranch) dan apel hijau (malam, Washington); mangga adalah tanaman pada liu2019monocular. Perbandingan pelacakan saja lawan pelacakan plus koreksi SfM, kode M3 lawan M3+M4, arah efek, dan metrik hitungan sudah benar. Teks h. 6 menulis 17,1% sedangkan tabel Gambar 7 menulis 17,2%.

klaim.halaman: Abstrak, h. 1; Gambar 5, h. 5; Seksi IV, h. 6
klaim.bukti: After localizing these fruit tracks in 3D, we can easily detect these double counted fruits since they will be close in 3D space. In addition, we can remove fruit outliers in terms of size.
klaim.perbaikan: Cite only [liu2019monocular] for trunk tracking, semantic structure from motion and reprojection of landmarks into every image. For [liu2018robust] write: 'an earlier monocular pipeline tracked fruit in 2D and used structure from motion to localise the tracks in 3D, rejecting double-counted tracks by their 3D proximity and outliers by depth and relative size'.
klaim.catatan: Makalah 2018 memang memakai kamera monokular dan pelacakan buah 2D (FCN, KLT, Kalman, Hungarian) dengan koreksi SfM. Namun, batang tidak dilacak, istilah semantic SfM tidak dipakai, dan jejak ganda dideteksi dari kedekatan posisi 3D, bukan dari proyeksi balik landmark ke setiap citra. Rincian tersebut milik liu2019monocular.

klaim.bukti: When combined with ByteTrack, it attained an average counting accuracy of 72.49% across blue, purple, and green maturity classes in video sequences.
klaim.catatan: Tabel 4 baris 'all': mPc 72,49% (biru 78,84%, ungu 74,38%, hijau 64,24%); angka itu rerata tiga video (69,07%, 74,94%, 73,45%).

klaim.bukti: a thermal camera was combined with a water spray system that applied water mist to citrus trees. The water mist caused temperatures of both the fruit and leaf surfaces to change but at different rates.
klaim.catatan: Abstrak juga menyebut algoritma pelacakan dan pencacahan pada video termal (mAP 87,2%, akurasi hitungan 96%) serta masalah kemiripan warna buah muda dan daun.
